newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Dena Bank 96/97 net up - paper.
newsitem.headline: India's Dena Bank 96/97 net up - paper.

text.p: State-run Dena Bank recorded a 41 percent jump in net profit to 720 million rupees in the year ended March 31, the Financial Express newspaper said on Tuesday.
The newspaper said the bank recommended a maiden dividend of 1.20 rupees for every 10 rupee share.

The bank's gross profit climbed to 1.72 billion rupees, from 1.45 billion in 1995/96 (April-March). Net non performing assets were down to nine percent of advances from 13 percent in the previous year.
The Financial Express said Dena Bank registered a 15 percent rise in its credit portfolio. The bank's aggregate deposits rose 20 percent over the previous year.
